name: openarch
description: CLI agent that containerizes GitHub repos on the fly, runs them in isolated Docker sandboxes, and exposes their CLIs as dynamic LLM tools.

scripts.build: bun build ./index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target node && bun run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const file = 'dist/index.js'; let content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); if (!content.startsWith('#!/usr/bin/env node')) { fs.writeFileSync(file, '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' + content); } fs.chmodSync(file, 0o755);"
